title: Lawyers protest slow progress of lawyer murder trial in Chattogram
seoTitle: Chattogram lawyers demand speedy murder trial

tea.why: Lawyers protested due to the slow progress and long delays in the murder trial of lawyer Saiful Islam Alif.
tea.want: They demanded an expedited trial, exemplary punishment for those responsible, and the swift issuance of the government gazette.
tea.changed: Nov 26, 2026: Lawyers formed a human chain, staged a demonstration, and held a rally at the Chattogram court premises.

summary: Lawyers and family members in Chattogram staged protests on the court premises to demand an expedited trial for the murder of lawyer Saiful Islam Alif, who was killed two years ago. The demonstrations were organised by the Bangladesh Jatiyatabadi Ainjibi Forum (Bangladesh Nationalist Lawyers' Forum) and the Chattogram District Bar Association. Protesters expressed deep concern over the slow judicial progress, noting that only four of the 49 witnesses had testified so far. They called on the government to promptly issue the necessary notification to transfer the case to the Speedy Trial Tribunal and urged authorities to bring those responsible to justice without further delay.
demands: Transfer the murder case to the Speedy Trial Tribunal
Bring those responsible for the killing to justice
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Lawyers formed a human chain and staged demonstrations at the Chattogram court premises demanding a speedy trial.
Lawyers staged a protest march and held a rally on the court premises to press for an accelerated judicial process.
